reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, correctly linking local chemical fluctuations and force-constant distortions to enhanced phonon scattering and lower thermal conductivity in single-phase HEAs, though the claimed 10–20% improvement is arbitrary and the mechanism is described generically.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, but the falsification criterion is ambiguous because it mixes two conditions (statistical improvement and a 20% deviation threshold) without specifying which single outcome would decisively falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core challenge of predicting low thermal conductivity in HEAs and proposes a concrete, if generic, descriptor-based approach, making it a useful starting point for experimental validation.
